findings.title: Service port's protocol differs from the pods' port
findings.cause: Service syslog's port 5140 is TCP, but the pods declare its target port 5140 as UDP only: Kubernetes forwards only TCP for that port, so UDP traffic to the Service never reaches them

evidence.command: kubectl get service syslog -n kd-service-protocol-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports}'

evidence.what: the selected pods declare port 5140 as UDP
evidence.command: kubectl get pod syslog-7bc6df7679-p6sds -n kd-service-protocol-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

findings.fix: Add a Service port with protocol UDP for it (a Service may list the same port number once per protocol, as DNS does with 53/UDP and 53/TCP), or correct the protocol.
